rank_population: eligible FBS teams with at least one completed game in the selected timeframe

metric_definitions.pointsPerGame: Official completed-game team points divided by selected games.
metric_definitions.yardsPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN net passing yards plus rushing yards, divided by the same selected games.
metric_definitions.yardsAllowedPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN opponent net passing yards plus rushing yards, divided by the same selected games; differences from the provider total-yards row are diagnostic warnings.
metric_definitions.playsPerGame: Official passing attempts plus rushing attempts, divided by selected games; must reconcile to the source total plays.
metric_definitions.completionPct: Aggregate completions divided by aggregate passing attempts; not an average of game percentages.
metric_definitions.yardsPerAttempt: Aggregate SportsDataverse/ESPN net passing yards divided by aggregate pass attempts.
metric_definitions.netYardsPerAttempt: Aggregate SportsDataverse/ESPN net passing yards divided by pass attempts plus sacks allowed; sack yards are already netted and are not subtracted twice.
metric_definitions.yardsPerCarry: Aggregate rushing yards divided by aggregate rushing attempts.
metric_definitions.yardsPerPlay: Aggregate total offensive yards divided by aggregate official offensive plays.
metric_definitions.firstDownRate: Aggregate first downs divided by official offensive plays.
metric_definitions.pointsPerDrive: Official offense-drive point changes divided by offense drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metric_definitions.pointsAllowedPerDrive: Opponent offense-drive point changes divided by opponent drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metric_definitions.sackRateAllowed: Offense sacks allowed divided by pass attempts plus sacks allowed; sacks allowed are counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags credited to the opposing defense.
metric_definitions.sackRate: Defensive sacks counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags, divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks.
metric_definitions.pressureRateAllowed: Sacks allowed plus opponent defensive QB hurries divided by team pass attempts plus sacks allowed; null if either event source is incomplete.
metric_definitions.pressureRate: Defensive sacks plus defensive QB hurries divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks; null if either event source is incomplete.
metric_definitions.fumblesForced: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP forced_fumble events credited to the defense; never substituted with fumbles recovered.
metric_definitions.turnoversForced: Opponent interceptions thrown plus opponent fumbles lost, or the explicit opponent box-score turnover total when present.
metric_definitions.takeawayRate: Turnovers forced divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metric_definitions.tackleForLossPct: Defensive tackles for loss divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metric_definitions.defensiveEpaPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent scrimmage play; sourced from complete /plays coverage or the SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense field.
metric_definitions.passEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent pass or sack play; lower is better.
metric_definitions.rushEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent rushing play; lower is better.
metric_definitions.defensiveSuccessRate: Share of opponent scrimmage plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; source-derived from complete /plays coverage or season advanced defense.
metric_definitions.passSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent pass and sack plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metric_definitions.rushSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent rush plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metric_definitions.explosivePassRateAllowed: Opponent pass plays gaining at least 20 yards divided by opponent pass plays.
metric_definitions.explosiveRunRateAllowed: Opponent rushes gaining at least 10 yards divided by opponent rush attempts.
metric_definitions.redZoneScorePctAllowed: Opponent scoring red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metric_definitions.redZoneTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metric_definitions.goalToGoTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown drives among drives with a goal-to-go scrimmage play (within 10 yards and distance to go reaches the goal line).
metric_definitions.twoMinuteDefensePpa: SportsDataverse/ESPN play PPA average allowed on scrimmage plays in the final two minutes of the second and fourth quarters; lower is better.
metric_definitions.stuffRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defensive stuff rate; kept separate from offensive stuff rate.
metric_definitions.adjustedLineYardsAllowed: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP line yards summed over the selected games and divided by opponent rush attempts.
metric_definitions.havocRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense.havoc.total, using SportsDataverse/ESPN source definition; no event count is reconstructed locally.
metric_definitions.passesDeflectedPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP pass_breakup events credited to the defense per completed game; interceptions are not added.
metric_definitions.ncaaPasserRating: NCAA passing-efficiency formula, not NFL passer rating.
metric_definitions.explosivePlays: SportsDataverse/ESPN EPA-defined explosive pass/rush flags from play-by-play, divided by eligible attempts; yardage thresholds are used only when those flags are unavailable.
metric_definitions.advancedLineStats: SportsDataverse/ESPN play-by-play line-yard decomposition aggregated across the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP fields.
metric_definitions.passPpaTotal: Sum of pass-attempt PPA from the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP coverage.
metric_definitions.redZone: Drive-derived red-zone entries; scoring rate includes any points, while touchdown rate counts touchdowns only.
metric_definitions.ranking: FBS teams with at least one completed game in the selected timeframe; competition ranking, exact ties share a rank, missing values are excluded. Volume and pace ranks are ordinal, not performance grades.

af.rankPopulation: FBS teams with at least one completed game in the selected timeframe
af.rankPolicy: Competition ranks use unrounded aggregates and exact ties share a rank. Offense ranks lower turnover rate, penalties/game, penalty yards/game, interception rate, sack rate allowed, pressure rate allowed, sack+hurry rate allowed, sacks allowed/game, QB hurries allowed/game, stuff rate, and seconds/play as better; every other offense stat ranks higher as better. Defense ranks lower points/yards/efficiency allowed, penalties, penalty yards, passing/rushing production and efficiency allowed, scoring and conversion rates allowed, adjusted line yards allowed, and situational points/PPA allowed as better; it ranks higher plays faced, takeaways/INTs, sack/pressure/hurry production, havoc, passes deflected, rush attempts faced, stuff rate, and tackles for loss. Other defense and special-teams stats retain their existing direction rules.

Defense ranks lower points/yards/efficiency allowed, penalties, penalty yards, passing/rushing production and efficiency allowed, scoring and conversion rates allowed, adjusted line yards allowed, and situational points/PPA allowed as better; it ranks higher plays faced, takeaways/INTs, sack/pressure/hurry production, havoc, passes deflected, rush attempts faced, stuff rate, and tackles for loss. metricDefinitions.pointsPerGame: Official completed-game team points divided by selected games.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN net passing yards plus rushing yards, divided by the same selected games.
metricDefinitions.yardsAllowedPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN opponent net passing yards plus rushing yards, divided by the same selected games; differences from the provider total-yards row are diagnostic warnings.
metricDefinitions.playsPerGame: Official passing attempts plus rushing attempts, divided by selected games; must reconcile to the source total plays.
metricDefinitions.completionPct: Aggregate completions divided by aggregate passing attempts; not an average of game percentages.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerAttempt: Aggregate SportsDataverse/ESPN net passing yards divided by aggregate pass attempts.
metricDefinitions.netYardsPerAttempt: Aggregate SportsDataverse/ESPN net passing yards divided by pass attempts plus sacks allowed; sack yards are already netted and are not subtracted twice.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerCarry: Aggregate rushing yards divided by aggregate rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerPlay: Aggregate total offensive yards divided by aggregate official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.firstDownRate: Aggregate first downs divided by official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.pointsPerDrive: Official offense-drive point changes divided by offense drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.pointsAllowedPerDrive: Opponent offense-drive point changes divided by opponent drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.sackRateAllowed: Offense sacks allowed divided by pass attempts plus sacks allowed; sacks allowed are counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags credited to the opposing defense.
metricDefinitions.sackRate: Defensive sacks counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags, divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks.
metricDefinitions.pressureRateAllowed: Sacks allowed plus opponent defensive QB hurries divided by team pass attempts plus sacks allowed; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.pressureRate: Defensive sacks plus defensive QB hurries divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.fumblesForced: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP forced_fumble events credited to the defense; never substituted with fumbles recovered.
metricDefinitions.turnoversForced: Opponent interceptions thrown plus opponent fumbles lost, or the explicit opponent box-score turnover total when present.
metricDefinitions.takeawayRate: Turnovers forced divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.tackleForLossPct: Defensive tackles for loss divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.defensiveEpaPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent scrimmage play; sourced from complete /plays coverage or the SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense field.
metricDefinitions.passEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent pass or sack play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent rushing play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.defensiveSuccessRate: Share of opponent scrimmage plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; source-derived from complete /plays coverage or season advanced defense.
metricDefinitions.passSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent pass and sack plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent rush plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.explosivePassRateAllowed: Opponent pass plays gaining at least 20 yards divided by opponent pass plays.
metricDefinitions.explosiveRunRateAllowed: Opponent rushes gaining at least 10 yards divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.redZoneScorePctAllowed: Opponent scoring red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.redZoneTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.goalToGoTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown drives among drives with a goal-to-go scrimmage play (within 10 yards and distance to go reaches the goal line).
metricDefinitions.twoMinuteDefensePpa: SportsDataverse/ESPN play PPA average allowed on scrimmage plays in the final two minutes of the second and fourth quarters; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.stuffRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defensive stuff rate; kept separate from offensive stuff rate.
metricDefinitions.adjustedLineYardsAllowed: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP line yards summed over the selected games and divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.havocRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense.havoc.total, using SportsDataverse/ESPN source definition; no event count is reconstructed locally.
metricDefinitions.passesDeflectedPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP pass_breakup events credited to the defense per completed game; interceptions are not added.
metricDefinitions.ncaaPasserRating: NCAA passing-efficiency formula, not NFL passer rating.
metricDefinitions.explosivePlays: SportsDataverse/ESPN EPA-defined explosive pass/rush flags from play-by-play, divided by eligible attempts; yardage thresholds are used only when those flags are unavailable.
metricDefinitions.advancedLineStats: SportsDataverse/ESPN play-by-play line-yard decomposition aggregated across the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP fields.
metricDefinitions.passPpaTotal: Sum of pass-attempt PPA from the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP coverage.
metricDefinitions.redZone: Drive-derived red-zone entries; scoring rate includes any points, while touchdown rate counts touchdowns only.
metricDefinitions.ranking: FBS teams with at least one completed game in the selected timeframe; competition ranking, exact ties share a rank, missing values are excluded. Volume and pace ranks are ordinal, not performance grades.

metricDefinitions.yardsPerPlay: Aggregate total offensive yards divided by aggregate official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.firstDownRate: Aggregate first downs divided by official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.pointsPerDrive: Official offense-drive point changes divided by offense drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.pointsAllowedPerDrive: Opponent offense-drive point changes divided by opponent drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.sackRateAllowed: Offense sacks allowed divided by pass attempts plus sacks allowed; sacks allowed are counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags credited to the opposing defense.
metricDefinitions.sackRate: Defensive sacks counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags, divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks.
metricDefinitions.pressureRateAllowed: Sacks allowed plus opponent defensive QB hurries divided by team pass attempts plus sacks allowed; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.pressureRate: Defensive sacks plus defensive QB hurries divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.fumblesForced: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP forced_fumble events credited to the defense; never substituted with fumbles recovered.
metricDefinitions.turnoversForced: Opponent interceptions thrown plus opponent fumbles lost, or the explicit opponent box-score turnover total when present.
metricDefinitions.takeawayRate: Turnovers forced divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.tackleForLossPct: Defensive tackles for loss divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.defensiveEpaPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent scrimmage play; sourced from complete /plays coverage or the SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense field.
metricDefinitions.passEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent pass or sack play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent rushing play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.defensiveSuccessRate: Share of opponent scrimmage plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; source-derived from complete /plays coverage or season advanced defense.
metricDefinitions.passSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent pass and sack plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent rush plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.explosivePassRateAllowed: Opponent pass plays gaining at least 20 yards divided by opponent pass plays.
metricDefinitions.explosiveRunRateAllowed: Opponent rushes gaining at least 10 yards divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.redZoneScorePctAllowed: Opponent scoring red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.redZoneTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.goalToGoTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown drives among drives with a goal-to-go scrimmage play (within 10 yards and distance to go reaches the goal line).
metricDefinitions.twoMinuteDefensePpa: SportsDataverse/ESPN play PPA average allowed on scrimmage plays in the final two minutes of the second and fourth quarters; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.stuffRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defensive stuff rate; kept separate from offensive stuff rate.
metricDefinitions.adjustedLineYardsAllowed: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP line yards summed over the selected games and divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.havocRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense.havoc.total, using SportsDataverse/ESPN source definition; no event count is reconstructed locally.
metricDefinitions.passesDeflectedPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP pass_breakup events credited to the defense per completed game; interceptions are not added.
metricDefinitions.ncaaPasserRating: NCAA passing-efficiency formula, not NFL passer rating.
metricDefinitions.explosivePlays: SportsDataverse/ESPN EPA-defined explosive pass/rush flags from play-by-play, divided by eligible attempts; yardage thresholds are used only when those flags are unavailable.

metricDefinitions.redZone: Drive-derived red-zone entries; scoring rate includes any points, while touchdown rate counts touchdowns only.

metricDefinitions.pointsPerGame: Official completed-game team points divided by selected games.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN net passing yards plus rushing yards, divided by the same selected games.
metricDefinitions.yardsAllowedPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN opponent net passing yards plus rushing yards, divided by the same selected games; differences from the provider total-yards row are diagnostic warnings.
metricDefinitions.playsPerGame: Official passing attempts plus rushing attempts, divided by selected games; must reconcile to the source total plays.
metricDefinitions.completionPct: Aggregate completions divided by aggregate passing attempts; not an average of game percentages.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerAttempt: Aggregate SportsDataverse/ESPN net passing yards divided by aggregate pass attempts.
metricDefinitions.netYardsPerAttempt: Aggregate SportsDataverse/ESPN net passing yards divided by pass attempts plus sacks allowed; sack yards are already netted and are not subtracted twice.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerCarry: Aggregate rushing yards divided by aggregate rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerPlay: Aggregate total offensive yards divided by aggregate official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.firstDownRate: Aggregate first downs divided by official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.pointsPerDrive: Official offense-drive point changes divided by offense drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.pointsAllowedPerDrive: Opponent offense-drive point changes divided by opponent drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.sackRateAllowed: Offense sacks allowed divided by pass attempts plus sacks allowed; sacks allowed are counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags credited to the opposing defense.
metricDefinitions.sackRate: Defensive sacks counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags, divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks.
metricDefinitions.pressureRateAllowed: Sacks allowed plus opponent defensive QB hurries divided by team pass attempts plus sacks allowed; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.pressureRate: Defensive sacks plus defensive QB hurries divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.fumblesForced: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP forced_fumble events credited to the defense; never substituted with fumbles recovered.
metricDefinitions.turnoversForced: Opponent interceptions thrown plus opponent fumbles lost, or the explicit opponent box-score turnover total when present.
metricDefinitions.takeawayRate: Turnovers forced divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.tackleForLossPct: Defensive tackles for loss divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.defensiveEpaPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent scrimmage play; sourced from complete /plays coverage or the SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense field.
metricDefinitions.passEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent pass or sack play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent rushing play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.defensiveSuccessRate: Share of opponent scrimmage plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; source-derived from complete /plays coverage or season advanced defense.
metricDefinitions.passSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent pass and sack plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent rush plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.explosivePassRateAllowed: Opponent pass plays gaining at least 20 yards divided by opponent pass plays.
metricDefinitions.explosiveRunRateAllowed: Opponent rushes gaining at least 10 yards divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.redZoneScorePctAllowed: Opponent scoring red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.redZoneTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.goalToGoTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown drives among drives with a goal-to-go scrimmage play (within 10 yards and distance to go reaches the goal line).
metricDefinitions.twoMinuteDefensePpa: SportsDataverse/ESPN play PPA average allowed on scrimmage plays in the final two minutes of the second and fourth quarters; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.stuffRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defensive stuff rate; kept separate from offensive stuff rate.
metricDefinitions.adjustedLineYardsAllowed: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP line yards summed over the selected games and divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.havocRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense.havoc.total, using SportsDataverse/ESPN source definition; no event count is reconstructed locally.
metricDefinitions.passesDeflectedPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP pass_breakup events credited to the defense per completed game; interceptions are not added.
metricDefinitions.ncaaPasserRating: NCAA passing-efficiency formula, not NFL passer rating.
metricDefinitions.explosivePlays: SportsDataverse/ESPN EPA-defined explosive pass/rush flags from play-by-play, divided by eligible attempts; yardage thresholds are used only when those flags are unavailable.
metricDefinitions.advancedLineStats: SportsDataverse/ESPN play-by-play line-yard decomposition aggregated across the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP fields.
metricDefinitions.passPpaTotal: Sum of pass-attempt PPA from the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP coverage.
metricDefinitions.redZone: Drive-derived red-zone entries; scoring rate includes any points, while touchdown rate counts touchdowns only.
metricDefinitions.ranking: FBS teams with at least one completed game in the selected timeframe; competition ranking, exact ties share a rank, missing values are excluded. Volume and pace ranks are ordinal, not performance grades.

metricDefinitions.playsPerGame: Official passing attempts plus rushing attempts, divided by selected games; must reconcile to the source total plays.
metricDefinitions.completionPct: Aggregate completions divided by aggregate passing attempts; not an average of game percentages.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerAttempt: Aggregate SportsDataverse/ESPN net passing yards divided by aggregate pass attempts.
metricDefinitions.netYardsPerAttempt: Aggregate SportsDataverse/ESPN net passing yards divided by pass attempts plus sacks allowed; sack yards are already netted and are not subtracted twice.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerCarry: Aggregate rushing yards divided by aggregate rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerPlay: Aggregate total offensive yards divided by aggregate official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.firstDownRate: Aggregate first downs divided by official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.pointsPerDrive: Official offense-drive point changes divided by offense drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.pointsAllowedPerDrive: Opponent offense-drive point changes divided by opponent drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.sackRateAllowed: Offense sacks allowed divided by pass attempts plus sacks allowed; sacks allowed are counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags credited to the opposing defense.
metricDefinitions.sackRate: Defensive sacks counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags, divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks.
metricDefinitions.pressureRateAllowed: Sacks allowed plus opponent defensive QB hurries divided by team pass attempts plus sacks allowed; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.pressureRate: Defensive sacks plus defensive QB hurries divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.fumblesForced: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP forced_fumble events credited to the defense; never substituted with fumbles recovered.
metricDefinitions.turnoversForced: Opponent interceptions thrown plus opponent fumbles lost, or the explicit opponent box-score turnover total when present.
metricDefinitions.takeawayRate: Turnovers forced divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.tackleForLossPct: Defensive tackles for loss divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.defensiveEpaPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent scrimmage play; sourced from complete /plays coverage or the SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense field.
metricDefinitions.passEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent pass or sack play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent rushing play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.defensiveSuccessRate: Share of opponent scrimmage plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; source-derived from complete /plays coverage or season advanced defense.
metricDefinitions.passSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent pass and sack plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent rush plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.explosivePassRateAllowed: Opponent pass plays gaining at least 20 yards divided by opponent pass plays.
metricDefinitions.explosiveRunRateAllowed: Opponent rushes gaining at least 10 yards divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.redZoneScorePctAllowed: Opponent scoring red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.redZoneTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.goalToGoTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown drives among drives with a goal-to-go scrimmage play (within 10 yards and distance to go reaches the goal line).
metricDefinitions.twoMinuteDefensePpa: SportsDataverse/ESPN play PPA average allowed on scrimmage plays in the final two minutes of the second and fourth quarters; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.stuffRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defensive stuff rate; kept separate from offensive stuff rate.
metricDefinitions.adjustedLineYardsAllowed: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP line yards summed over the selected games and divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.havocRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense.havoc.total, using SportsDataverse/ESPN source definition; no event count is reconstructed locally.
metricDefinitions.passesDeflectedPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP pass_breakup events credited to the defense per completed game; interceptions are not added.
metricDefinitions.ncaaPasserRating: NCAA passing-efficiency formula, not NFL passer rating.
metricDefinitions.explosivePlays: SportsDataverse/ESPN EPA-defined explosive pass/rush flags from play-by-play, divided by eligible attempts; yardage thresholds are used only when those flags are unavailable.
metricDefinitions.advancedLineStats: SportsDataverse/ESPN play-by-play line-yard decomposition aggregated across the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP fields.
metricDefinitions.passPpaTotal: Sum of pass-attempt PPA from the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP coverage.
metricDefinitions.redZone: Drive-derived red-zone entries; scoring rate includes any points, while touchdown rate counts touchdowns only.
metricDefinitions.ranking: FBS teams with at least one completed game in the selected timeframe; competition ranking, exact ties share a rank, missing values are excluded. Volume and pace ranks are ordinal, not performance grades.

kenn.rankPopulation: FBS teams with at least one completed game in the selected timeframe
kenn.rankPolicy: Competition ranks use unrounded aggregates and exact ties share a rank. Offense ranks lower turnover rate, penalties/game, penalty yards/game, interception rate, sack rate allowed, pressure rate allowed, sack+hurry rate allowed, sacks allowed/game, QB hurries allowed/game, stuff rate, and seconds/play as better; every other offense stat ranks higher as better. Defense ranks lower points/yards/efficiency allowed, penalties, penalty yards, passing/rushing production and efficiency allowed, scoring and conversion rates allowed, adjusted line yards allowed, and situational points/PPA allowed as better; it ranks higher plays faced, takeaways/INTs, sack/pressure/hurry production, havoc, passes deflected, rush attempts faced, stuff rate, and tackles for loss. Other defense and special-teams stats retain their existing direction rules.

metricDefinitions.yardsPerPlay: Aggregate total offensive yards divided by aggregate official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.firstDownRate: Aggregate first downs divided by official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.pointsPerDrive: Official offense-drive point changes divided by offense drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.pointsAllowedPerDrive: Opponent offense-drive point changes divided by opponent drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.sackRateAllowed: Offense sacks allowed divided by pass attempts plus sacks allowed; sacks allowed are counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags credited to the opposing defense.
metricDefinitions.sackRate: Defensive sacks counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags, divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks.
metricDefinitions.pressureRateAllowed: Sacks allowed plus opponent defensive QB hurries divided by team pass attempts plus sacks allowed; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.pressureRate: Defensive sacks plus defensive QB hurries divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.fumblesForced: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP forced_fumble events credited to the defense; never substituted with fumbles recovered.
metricDefinitions.turnoversForced: Opponent interceptions thrown plus opponent fumbles lost, or the explicit opponent box-score turnover total when present.
metricDefinitions.takeawayRate: Turnovers forced divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.tackleForLossPct: Defensive tackles for loss divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.defensiveEpaPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent scrimmage play; sourced from complete /plays coverage or the SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense field.
metricDefinitions.passEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent pass or sack play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent rushing play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.defensiveSuccessRate: Share of opponent scrimmage plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; source-derived from complete /plays coverage or season advanced defense.
metricDefinitions.passSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent pass and sack plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent rush plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.explosivePassRateAllowed: Opponent pass plays gaining at least 20 yards divided by opponent pass plays.
metricDefinitions.explosiveRunRateAllowed: Opponent rushes gaining at least 10 yards divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.redZoneScorePctAllowed: Opponent scoring red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.redZoneTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.goalToGoTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown drives among drives with a goal-to-go scrimmage play (within 10 yards and distance to go reaches the goal line).
metricDefinitions.twoMinuteDefensePpa: SportsDataverse/ESPN play PPA average allowed on scrimmage plays in the final two minutes of the second and fourth quarters; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.stuffRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defensive stuff rate; kept separate from offensive stuff rate.
metricDefinitions.adjustedLineYardsAllowed: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP line yards summed over the selected games and divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.havocRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense.havoc.total, using SportsDataverse/ESPN source definition; no event count is reconstructed locally.
metricDefinitions.passesDeflectedPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP pass_breakup events credited to the defense per completed game; interceptions are not added.
metricDefinitions.ncaaPasserRating: NCAA passing-efficiency formula, not NFL passer rating.
metricDefinitions.explosivePlays: SportsDataverse/ESPN EPA-defined explosive pass/rush flags from play-by-play, divided by eligible attempts; yardage thresholds are used only when those flags are unavailable.
metricDefinitions.advancedLineStats: SportsDataverse/ESPN play-by-play line-yard decomposition aggregated across the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP fields.
metricDefinitions.passPpaTotal: Sum of pass-attempt PPA from the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP coverage.
metricDefinitions.redZone: Drive-derived red-zone entries; scoring rate includes any points, while touchdown rate counts touchdowns only.

metricDefinitions.explosivePassRateAllowed: Opponent pass plays gaining at least 20 yards divided by opponent pass plays.
metricDefinitions.explosiveRunRateAllowed: Opponent rushes gaining at least 10 yards divided by opponent rush attempts.

metricDefinitions.redZoneTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.

metricDefinitions.stuffRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defensive stuff rate; kept separate from offensive stuff rate.

metricDefinitions.passPpaTotal: Sum of pass-attempt PPA from the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP coverage.
metricDefinitions.redZone: Drive-derived red-zone entries; scoring rate includes any points, while touchdown rate counts touchdowns only.

metricDefinitions.firstDownRate: Aggregate first downs divided by official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.pointsPerDrive: Official offense-drive point changes divided by offense drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.pointsAllowedPerDrive: Opponent offense-drive point changes divided by opponent drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.sackRateAllowed: Offense sacks allowed divided by pass attempts plus sacks allowed; sacks allowed are counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags credited to the opposing defense.
metricDefinitions.sackRate: Defensive sacks counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags, divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks.
metricDefinitions.pressureRateAllowed: Sacks allowed plus opponent defensive QB hurries divided by team pass attempts plus sacks allowed; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.pressureRate: Defensive sacks plus defensive QB hurries divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.fumblesForced: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP forced_fumble events credited to the defense; never substituted with fumbles recovered.
metricDefinitions.turnoversForced: Opponent interceptions thrown plus opponent fumbles lost, or the explicit opponent box-score turnover total when present.
metricDefinitions.takeawayRate: Turnovers forced divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.tackleForLossPct: Defensive tackles for loss divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.defensiveEpaPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent scrimmage play; sourced from complete /plays coverage or the SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense field.
metricDefinitions.passEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent pass or sack play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent rushing play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.defensiveSuccessRate: Share of opponent scrimmage plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; source-derived from complete /plays coverage or season advanced defense.
metricDefinitions.passSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent pass and sack plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent rush plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.explosivePassRateAllowed: Opponent pass plays gaining at least 20 yards divided by opponent pass plays.
metricDefinitions.explosiveRunRateAllowed: Opponent rushes gaining at least 10 yards divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.redZoneScorePctAllowed: Opponent scoring red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.redZoneTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.goalToGoTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown drives among drives with a goal-to-go scrimmage play (within 10 yards and distance to go reaches the goal line).
metricDefinitions.twoMinuteDefensePpa: SportsDataverse/ESPN play PPA average allowed on scrimmage plays in the final two minutes of the second and fourth quarters; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.stuffRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defensive stuff rate; kept separate from offensive stuff rate.
metricDefinitions.adjustedLineYardsAllowed: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP line yards summed over the selected games and divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.havocRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense.havoc.total, using SportsDataverse/ESPN source definition; no event count is reconstructed locally.
metricDefinitions.passesDeflectedPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP pass_breakup events credited to the defense per completed game; interceptions are not added.
metricDefinitions.ncaaPasserRating: NCAA passing-efficiency formula, not NFL passer rating.
metricDefinitions.explosivePlays: SportsDataverse/ESPN EPA-defined explosive pass/rush flags from play-by-play, divided by eligible attempts; yardage thresholds are used only when those flags are unavailable.
metricDefinitions.advancedLineStats: SportsDataverse/ESPN play-by-play line-yard decomposition aggregated across the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP fields.
metricDefinitions.passPpaTotal: Sum of pass-attempt PPA from the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP coverage.
metricDefinitions.redZone: Drive-derived red-zone entries; scoring rate includes any points, while touchdown rate counts touchdowns only.
metricDefinitions.ranking: FBS teams with at least one completed game in the selected timeframe; competition ranking, exact ties share a rank, missing values are excluded. Volume and pace ranks are ordinal, not performance grades.

metricDefinitions.yardsPerPlay: Aggregate total offensive yards divided by aggregate official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.firstDownRate: Aggregate first downs divided by official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.pointsPerDrive: Official offense-drive point changes divided by offense drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.pointsAllowedPerDrive: Opponent offense-drive point changes divided by opponent drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.sackRateAllowed: Offense sacks allowed divided by pass attempts plus sacks allowed; sacks allowed are counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags credited to the opposing defense.
metricDefinitions.sackRate: Defensive sacks counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags, divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks.
metricDefinitions.pressureRateAllowed: Sacks allowed plus opponent defensive QB hurries divided by team pass attempts plus sacks allowed; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.pressureRate: Defensive sacks plus defensive QB hurries divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.fumblesForced: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP forced_fumble events credited to the defense; never substituted with fumbles recovered.
metricDefinitions.turnoversForced: Opponent interceptions thrown plus opponent fumbles lost, or the explicit opponent box-score turnover total when present.
metricDefinitions.takeawayRate: Turnovers forced divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.tackleForLossPct: Defensive tackles for loss divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.defensiveEpaPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent scrimmage play; sourced from complete /plays coverage or the SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense field.
metricDefinitions.passEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent pass or sack play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent rushing play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.defensiveSuccessRate: Share of opponent scrimmage plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; source-derived from complete /plays coverage or season advanced defense.
metricDefinitions.passSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent pass and sack plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent rush plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.explosivePassRateAllowed: Opponent pass plays gaining at least 20 yards divided by opponent pass plays.
metricDefinitions.explosiveRunRateAllowed: Opponent rushes gaining at least 10 yards divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.redZoneScorePctAllowed: Opponent scoring red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.redZoneTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.goalToGoTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown drives among drives with a goal-to-go scrimmage play (within 10 yards and distance to go reaches the goal line).
metricDefinitions.twoMinuteDefensePpa: SportsDataverse/ESPN play PPA average allowed on scrimmage plays in the final two minutes of the second and fourth quarters; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.stuffRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defensive stuff rate; kept separate from offensive stuff rate.
metricDefinitions.adjustedLineYardsAllowed: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP line yards summed over the selected games and divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.havocRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense.havoc.total, using SportsDataverse/ESPN source definition; no event count is reconstructed locally.
metricDefinitions.passesDeflectedPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP pass_breakup events credited to the defense per completed game; interceptions are not added.
metricDefinitions.ncaaPasserRating: NCAA passing-efficiency formula, not NFL passer rating.
metricDefinitions.explosivePlays: SportsDataverse/ESPN EPA-defined explosive pass/rush flags from play-by-play, divided by eligible attempts; yardage thresholds are used only when those flags are unavailable.
metricDefinitions.advancedLineStats: SportsDataverse/ESPN play-by-play line-yard decomposition aggregated across the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP fields.
metricDefinitions.passPpaTotal: Sum of pass-attempt PPA from the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP coverage.
metricDefinitions.redZone: Drive-derived red-zone entries; scoring rate includes any points, while touchdown rate counts touchdowns only.
metricDefinitions.ranking: FBS teams with at least one completed game in the selected timeframe; competition ranking, exact ties share a rank, missing values are excluded. Volume and pace ranks are ordinal, not performance grades.

metricDefinitions.pointsPerGame: Official completed-game team points divided by selected games.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN net passing yards plus rushing yards, divided by the same selected games.
metricDefinitions.yardsAllowedPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN opponent net passing yards plus rushing yards, divided by the same selected games; differences from the provider total-yards row are diagnostic warnings.
metricDefinitions.playsPerGame: Official passing attempts plus rushing attempts, divided by selected games; must reconcile to the source total plays.
metricDefinitions.completionPct: Aggregate completions divided by aggregate passing attempts; not an average of game percentages.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerAttempt: Aggregate SportsDataverse/ESPN net passing yards divided by aggregate pass attempts.
metricDefinitions.netYardsPerAttempt: Aggregate SportsDataverse/ESPN net passing yards divided by pass attempts plus sacks allowed; sack yards are already netted and are not subtracted twice.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerCarry: Aggregate rushing yards divided by aggregate rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerPlay: Aggregate total offensive yards divided by aggregate official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.firstDownRate: Aggregate first downs divided by official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.pointsPerDrive: Official offense-drive point changes divided by offense drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.pointsAllowedPerDrive: Opponent offense-drive point changes divided by opponent drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.sackRateAllowed: Offense sacks allowed divided by pass attempts plus sacks allowed; sacks allowed are counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags credited to the opposing defense.
metricDefinitions.sackRate: Defensive sacks counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags, divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks.
metricDefinitions.pressureRateAllowed: Sacks allowed plus opponent defensive QB hurries divided by team pass attempts plus sacks allowed; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.pressureRate: Defensive sacks plus defensive QB hurries divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.fumblesForced: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP forced_fumble events credited to the defense; never substituted with fumbles recovered.
metricDefinitions.turnoversForced: Opponent interceptions thrown plus opponent fumbles lost, or the explicit opponent box-score turnover total when present.
metricDefinitions.takeawayRate: Turnovers forced divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.tackleForLossPct: Defensive tackles for loss divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.defensiveEpaPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent scrimmage play; sourced from complete /plays coverage or the SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense field.
metricDefinitions.passEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent pass or sack play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent rushing play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.defensiveSuccessRate: Share of opponent scrimmage plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; source-derived from complete /plays coverage or season advanced defense.
metricDefinitions.passSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent pass and sack plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent rush plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.explosivePassRateAllowed: Opponent pass plays gaining at least 20 yards divided by opponent pass plays.
metricDefinitions.explosiveRunRateAllowed: Opponent rushes gaining at least 10 yards divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.redZoneScorePctAllowed: Opponent scoring red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.redZoneTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.goalToGoTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown drives among drives with a goal-to-go scrimmage play (within 10 yards and distance to go reaches the goal line).
metricDefinitions.twoMinuteDefensePpa: SportsDataverse/ESPN play PPA average allowed on scrimmage plays in the final two minutes of the second and fourth quarters; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.stuffRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defensive stuff rate; kept separate from offensive stuff rate.
metricDefinitions.adjustedLineYardsAllowed: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP line yards summed over the selected games and divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.havocRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense.havoc.total, using SportsDataverse/ESPN source definition; no event count is reconstructed locally.
metricDefinitions.passesDeflectedPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP pass_breakup events credited to the defense per completed game; interceptions are not added.
metricDefinitions.ncaaPasserRating: NCAA passing-efficiency formula, not NFL passer rating.
metricDefinitions.explosivePlays: SportsDataverse/ESPN EPA-defined explosive pass/rush flags from play-by-play, divided by eligible attempts; yardage thresholds are used only when those flags are unavailable.
metricDefinitions.advancedLineStats: SportsDataverse/ESPN play-by-play line-yard decomposition aggregated across the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP fields.
metricDefinitions.passPpaTotal: Sum of pass-attempt PPA from the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP coverage.
metricDefinitions.redZone: Drive-derived red-zone entries; scoring rate includes any points, while touchdown rate counts touchdowns only.
metricDefinitions.ranking: FBS teams with at least one completed game in the selected timeframe; competition ranking, exact ties share a rank, missing values are excluded. Volume and pace ranks are ordinal, not performance grades.

metricDefinitions.yardsPerCarry: Aggregate rushing yards divided by aggregate rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.yardsPerPlay: Aggregate total offensive yards divided by aggregate official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.firstDownRate: Aggregate first downs divided by official offensive plays.
metricDefinitions.pointsPerDrive: Official offense-drive point changes divided by offense drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.pointsAllowedPerDrive: Opponent offense-drive point changes divided by opponent drives; excludes defensive and special-teams scores.
metricDefinitions.sackRateAllowed: Offense sacks allowed divided by pass attempts plus sacks allowed; sacks allowed are counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags credited to the opposing defense.
metricDefinitions.sackRate: Defensive sacks counted from SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP sack flags, divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks.
metricDefinitions.pressureRateAllowed: Sacks allowed plus opponent defensive QB hurries divided by team pass attempts plus sacks allowed; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.pressureRate: Defensive sacks plus defensive QB hurries divided by opponent pass attempts plus defensive sacks; null if either event source is incomplete.
metricDefinitions.fumblesForced: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP forced_fumble events credited to the defense; never substituted with fumbles recovered.
metricDefinitions.turnoversForced: Opponent interceptions thrown plus opponent fumbles lost, or the explicit opponent box-score turnover total when present.
metricDefinitions.takeawayRate: Turnovers forced divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.tackleForLossPct: Defensive tackles for loss divided by opponent passing attempts plus rushing attempts.
metricDefinitions.defensiveEpaPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent scrimmage play; sourced from complete /plays coverage or the SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense field.
metricDefinitions.passEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent pass or sack play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushEpaAllowedPerPlay: SportsDataverse/ESPN predicted points added (PPA) allowed per opponent rushing play; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.defensiveSuccessRate: Share of opponent scrimmage plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; source-derived from complete /plays coverage or season advanced defense.
metricDefinitions.passSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent pass and sack plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.rushSuccessRateAllowed: Share of opponent rush plays meeting SportsDataverse/ESPN success criteria; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.explosivePassRateAllowed: Opponent pass plays gaining at least 20 yards divided by opponent pass plays.
metricDefinitions.explosiveRunRateAllowed: Opponent rushes gaining at least 10 yards divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.redZoneScorePctAllowed: Opponent scoring red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.redZoneTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown red-zone drives divided by opponent drives that had a scrimmage play inside the 20-yard line.
metricDefinitions.goalToGoTdPctAllowed: Opponent touchdown drives among drives with a goal-to-go scrimmage play (within 10 yards and distance to go reaches the goal line).
metricDefinitions.twoMinuteDefensePpa: SportsDataverse/ESPN play PPA average allowed on scrimmage plays in the final two minutes of the second and fourth quarters; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.stuffRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defensive stuff rate; kept separate from offensive stuff rate.
metricDefinitions.adjustedLineYardsAllowed: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP line yards summed over the selected games and divided by opponent rush attempts.
metricDefinitions.havocRate: SportsDataverse/ESPN season-advanced defense.havoc.total, using SportsDataverse/ESPN source definition; no event count is reconstructed locally.
metricDefinitions.passesDeflectedPerGame: SportsDataverse/ESPN PBP pass_breakup events credited to the defense per completed game; interceptions are not added.
metricDefinitions.ncaaPasserRating: NCAA passing-efficiency formula, not NFL passer rating.
metricDefinitions.explosivePlays: SportsDataverse/ESPN EPA-defined explosive pass/rush flags from play-by-play, divided by eligible attempts; yardage thresholds are used only when those flags are unavailable.
metricDefinitions.advancedLineStats: SportsDataverse/ESPN play-by-play line-yard decomposition aggregated across the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP fields.
metricDefinitions.passPpaTotal: Sum of pass-attempt PPA from the exact selected games; season advanced game totals fill any unavailable PBP coverage.
metricDefinitions.redZone: Drive-derived red-zone entries; scoring rate includes any points, while touchdown rate counts touchdowns only.
metricDefinitions.ranking: FBS teams with at least one completed game in the selected timeframe; competition ranking, exact ties share a rank, missing values are excluded. Volume and pace ranks are ordinal, not performance grades.

westernmichigan.rankPopulation: FBS teams with at least one completed game in the selected timeframe

Defense ranks lower points/yards/efficiency allowed, penalties, penalty yards, passing/rushing production and efficiency allowed, scoring and conversion rates allowed, adjusted line yards allowed, and situational points/PPA allowed as better; it ranks higher plays faced, takeaways/INTs, sack/pressure/hurry production, havoc, passes deflected, rush attempts faced, stuff rate, and tackles for loss. Other defense and special-teams stats retain their existing direction rules.

integrity.source: SportsDataverse cfbfastR/ESPN schedules, team/player box scores, advanced data, and complete play-by-play; aggregate and rank use the same selected game IDs
